description: Add structured logging, user visibility, and API endpoints for build pipeline observability

tasks.title: Add logging and events to runPipelineBuildStage
tasks.description: Add structured logging to runPipelineBuildStage in workflow-controller.ts: log detectOpenSpecChange result (change path or null with worktreePath), log tasks.json snapshot before/after ralph loop (total/pending/passed counts), log ralph loop result (completed/failed/total/success), add zero-work detection that returns success:false when completed===0 && total>0, emit SSE events (build_stage_started, build_tasks_snapshot, build_stage_completed/failed), write critical events to workflow_log.
acceptanceCriteria: detectOpenSpecChange result is logged at INFO when change found, WARN when null
Tasks snapshot (total, pending, passed counts) is logged before ralph loop
Ralph loop result (completed, failed, total, success) is logged after completion
When completed===0 && total>0, a WARN log is emitted and StageResult.success is false
SSE events are emitted: build_stage_started, build_tasks_snapshot, build_stage_completed/failed
Critical events are written to workflow_log
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use existing log instance. Import Log if not already imported. Add eventBus emissions at key points.

tasks.title: Add logging and events to runRalphLoop
tasks.description: Add structured logging to runRalphLoop in ralph-executor.ts: log tasks state on loop entry (total/pending/passed counts), log when findNextPendingTask returns null (WARN level), log each task attempt result, log task failures with category and error, write task events to workflow_log, emit SSE events for task progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks state (total, pending, passed) is logged at INFO on loop entry
When findNextPendingTask returns null immediately, a WARN log explains no pending tasks found
Each task attempt logs task id and attempt number
Task failures log at WARN level with failure category and error summary
Task events are written to workflow_log: task_started, task_completed, task_failed, task_retrying
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Add `const log = Log.create({ service: 'ralph' })` at the top of the file.

tasks.title: Fix swallow catch in workflow-controller and ralph-executor
tasks.description: Fix critical swallow catch blocks: add logging to eventBus.emit failures in workflow-controller.ts (lines ~100, 126), add logging to eventBus.emit failures in ralph-executor.ts (lines ~295, 311), add logging to writeTasksFile failures.
acceptanceCriteria: eventBus.emit failures in workflow-controller.ts are logged at WARN level
eventBus.emit failures in ralph-executor.ts are logged at WARN level
writeTasksFile failures are logged at ERROR level
All existing tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Be careful not to change behavior — only add logging. Keep fire-and-forget semantics.

tasks.title: Add build-status and tasks API endpoints
tasks.description: Add new API endpoints in issues.ts: GET /api/issues/:number/build-status returns current build stage, progress, and task list; GET /api/issues/:number/tasks returns tasks.json current state. Both endpoints should handle errors gracefully and return appropriate HTTP status codes.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number/build-status returns stage, status, progress, and tasks array
GET /api/issues/:number/tasks returns tasks.json current state
Both endpoints handle missing issue (404), missing project (400), and server errors (500)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow existing patterns in issues.ts for error handling and response format.

tasks.title: Add emitPersistent helper to EventBus
tasks.description: Add emitPersistent method to EventBus class in event-bus.ts: emitPersistent(event, data, { issueId, sessionId, workflowLogRepo }) emits event via EventBus AND writes to workflow_log, catches and logs errors from either operation, returns void (fire-and-forget).
acceptanceCriteria: emitPersistent method exists on EventBus class
Method emits event via EventBus
Method writes event to workflow_log when workflowLogRepo is provided
Errors from either operation are logged but don't throw
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is a utility method. It should not change existing EventBus.emit behavior.

ACP session completion is logged with success/failure and duration
ACP session timeout is logged with timeout duration
